verified by

  • CURIE: gmeow:verifiedBy
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/verifiedBy
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/attestation
  • Box roles: CBox role, RBox role (What is this?)

The agent that produced a verification result. Non-functional: joint verification by multiple agents is valid.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:VerificationResult -> gmeow:Agent

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:verifiedBy from gmeow:VerificationResult to gmeow:Agent when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Software Release

# --- Verification is its own recorded act: the deploy gate checked the chain.
ex:verifyResult a gmeow:VerificationResult ;
    gmeow:hasVerificationStatus gmeow:verificationStatusVerified ;
    gmeow:verifiedBy            ex:relyingParty .

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:VerificationResult, gmeow:Agent

Usage Advice

Use when

  • Use to name the agent or software that produced a gmeow:VerificationResult — the verifier whose standpoint the verdict is held from (Principle 9: a result is one verifier's observation, not a global fact).

Avoid when

  • Avoid for the agent that ISSUED the attestation (that is gmeow:attester) and avoid forcing a single verifier — joint verification is valid, so it stays non-functional.

How to use

  • Bind the verifying gmeow:Agent on the VerificationResult; competing verdicts from different verifiers coexist as separate results, each with its own gmeow:verifiedBy.

Examples

  • ex:verifyOutcome gmeow:verifiedBy ex:ciVerifier.
